requirements.title: The harness MUST drive idle, playback, pan, zoom, selection, modality transition, and dense-overlay journeys through the built production client in Chromium. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: The harness MUST drive idle, playback, pan, zoom, selection, modality transition, and dense-overlay journeys through the built production client in Chromium. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: Each journey artifact MUST separately report worker compute and transfer, scene projection and allocation, Elmish update and React reconciliation, SVG style/layout/paint/compositor activity, DOM counts by layer, long tasks, dropped frames, and input-to-paint latency; frame and latency evidence MUST come from Chromium `AnimationFrame`, user `EventDispatch`, paint, and presentation trace events without injecting a sampling callback into the measured renderer, and unavailable capabilities MUST remain explicit rather than merged or invented. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: Each journey artifact MUST separately report worker compute and transfer, scene projection and allocation, Elmish update and React reconciliation, SVG style/layout/paint/compositor activity, DOM counts by layer, long tasks, dropped frames, and input-to-paint latency; frame and latency evidence MUST come from Chromium `AnimationFrame`, user `EventDispatch`, paint, and presentation trace events without injecting a sampling callback into the measured renderer, and unavailable capabilities MUST remain explicit rather than merged or invented. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: Every artifact MUST bind the exact candidate commit/tree and build identity, fixture schema/id/digest, journey id, Chromium and runtime versions, host/capability facts, content-addressed retained trace path/digest, start/end timestamps, and result; a clean archive MUST contain every declared compressed trace and validation MUST fail on absent, malformed, or changed decompressed bytes. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: Every artifact MUST bind the exact candidate commit/tree and build identity, fixture schema/id/digest, journey id, Chromium and runtime versions, host/capability facts, content-addressed retained trace path/digest, start/end timestamps, and result; a clean archive MUST contain every declared compressed trace and validation MUST fail on absent, malformed, or changed decompressed bytes. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: The versioned fixture matrix MUST independently vary map extent, visible density, global unit count, route/overlay complexity, event rate, and supporting-list size through a declared one-factor controlled pair for every axis, with declared expected scales and structural counters. (Stories: US-002, US-003; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: The versioned fixture matrix MUST independently vary map extent, visible density, global unit count, route/overlay complexity, event rate, and supporting-list size through a declared one-factor controlled pair for every axis, with declared expected scales and structural counters. (Stories: US-002, US-003; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: At least one paired large-project/small-viewport fixture MUST hold visible density and viewport constant while increasing global project scale, and the summary MUST keep global and visible working-set metrics distinct. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: At least one paired large-project/small-viewport fixture MUST hold visible density and viewport constant while increasing global project scale, and the summary MUST keep global and visible working-set metrics distinct. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: Repeated pan, zoom, and playback MUST record memory after warm-up and after a declared stabilization cycle count, including heap/DOM observations, delta, and whether collection control was available. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)
requirements.text: Repeated pan, zoom, and playback MUST record memory after warm-up and after a declared stabilization cycle count, including heap/DOM observations, delta, and whether collection control was available. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)

requirements.title: The deterministic summary MUST rank pipeline stages from observed duration/share and structural counters, identify the next material bottleneck with evidence references, and disclose ties or unavailable data. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: The deterministic summary MUST rank pipeline stages from observed duration/share and structural counters, identify the next material bottleneck with evidence references, and disclose ties or unavailable data. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-004)

requirements.title: The summary MUST classify packed worker transport, typed buffers, and further allocation work as required or deferred from the measured worker-transfer/projection/allocation shares, and MUST state that fixtures are regression workloads rather than supported-size ceilings. (Stories: US-001, US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: The summary MUST classify packed worker transport, typed buffers, and further allocation work as required or deferred from the measured worker-transfer/projection/allocation shares, and MUST state that fixtures are regression workloads rather than supported-size ceilings. (Stories: US-001, US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)

requirements.title: The harness MUST be independently runnable and focused, support selecting fixtures/journeys and an artifact directory, and MUST not be wired into the small-PR CI route. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-005)
requirements.text: The harness MUST be independently runnable and focused, support selecting fixtures/journeys and an artifact directory, and MUST not be wired into the small-PR CI route. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-005)

requirements.title: Committed tests MUST validate fixture/artifact schemas, route coverage, binding/digest checks, capability-safe failure, and summary classification, and subject mutations MUST make each new gate fail. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-005)
requirements.text: Committed tests MUST validate fixture/artifact schemas, route coverage, binding/digest checks, capability-safe failure, and summary classification, and subject mutations MUST make each new gate fail. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-005)

decisions.title: Versioned JSON fixture definitions generate maps that enter through the production import control; journeys use only production pointer, keyboard, menu, timeline, and workspace controls.
decisions.decision: Versioned JSON fixture definitions generate maps that enter through the production import control; journeys use only production pointer, keyboard, menu, timeline, and workspace controls.

decisions.title: A schema-v1 summary plus clean-archive-durable content-addressed raw Chromium traces is authoritative; trace-derived frame/input timing introduces no renderer sampling callback, and unavailable browser capabilities remain explicit unavailable observations rather than zero-valued successes.
decisions.decision: A schema-v1 summary plus clean-archive-durable content-addressed raw Chromium traces is authoritative; trace-derived frame/input timing introduces no renderer sampling callback, and unavailable browser capabilities remain explicit unavailable observations rather than zero-valued successes.

decisions.title: Memory uses two warm-up and five stabilization cycles, with identical pan/zoom/playback actions and separately labelled heap/DOM checkpoints.
decisions.decision: Memory uses two warm-up and five stabilization cycles, with identical pan/zoom/playback actions and separately labelled heap/DOM checkpoints.

decisions.title: The summary ranks measured stages and applies a versioned 20 percent material-share threshold for transport/allocation disposition; ties and missing data remain inconclusive/deferred, and no size ceiling is emitted.
decisions.decision: The summary ranks measured stages and applies a versioned 20 percent material-share threshold for transport/allocation disposition; ties and missing data remain inconclusive/deferred, and no size ceiling is emitted.
